issues.issue: The boxing-contest frame most naturally cued the decisive-defeat sense, absent from the supplied 痛打/严惩 gloss, and the translation added total helplessness.
issues.resolution: Recomposed a non-graphic fictional physical-beating scene that directly illustrates the supplied 痛打 sense and translated it faithfully.

issues.issue: The selected explanation added a shout sense to the supplied noun gloss 颂歌, while the sentence did not distinguish song from exclamation.
issues.resolution: Narrowed meaningZh to 颂歌 and explicitly made the choir sing one, preserving the canonical noun sense.

issues.issue: The Chinese specified tooth roots where the English base was less specific, adding an unnecessary anatomical location.
issues.resolution: Aligned both languages around tartar on tooth surfaces, a direct illustration of the confirmed dental noun.

issues.issue: The Chinese 已有近五十年 suggested service continuing up to the present, which was not stated by the English simple past.
issues.resolution: Changed the translation to 曾在这个湖上运送乘客近五十年 to preserve the past-service wording.

issues.issue: The translation added singing out of tune (走调), whereas the English described crackling and audio distortion.
issues.resolution: Removed 走调 and retained 噼啪作响、声音失真, with the vulgar/offensive register still marked.
